breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction by replacing the UDL with its resultant W = 900 N as a point load at midspan and computing deflection using WL³/(48EI). The correct approach (as in the ground truth) is to use the standard UDL midspan deflection formula δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI). The agent did not fix this error and instead faithfully reproduced the flawed methodology from the incomplete prompt.
